### **Editorial Plan: Viviana Matsuda – *Playful Pottery***

**Total Runtime:** ~60 Seconds  
**Mood:** Calm, inspiring, intimate, reflective  
**Music:** Ambient / Calm (`calm_ambient`)  

---

#### **Beat 1: Introduction (0:00 – 0:11)**
* **Visual:** Open cold on A-roll of Viviana seated in her studio, speaking directly to camera.
* **Audio:** Ambient room tone only (no music). Viviana introduces herself: *“I’m Viviana Matsuda. I do pottery for a living. My brand name is Mud Witch. I’m a full-time potter.”* [[clip: A001C002_240718OR | 14s-25s]]
* **Purpose:** Establish an intimate, grounded connection with Viviana and her craft before introducing musical accompaniment.

---

#### **Beat 2: Introducing *Playful Pottery* (0:11 – 0:28)**
* **Visual:** Transition from the interview to dynamic B-roll showcasing various finished pottery pieces and colorful glaze textures [[clip: B003C050_240719XK | 0.3s-5.8s]], cutting to detailed close-ups of ceramics [[clip: B003C050_240719XK | 9.6s-14.2s]] and raw clay work [[clip: B003C011_240719YX | 5.9s-9.1s]].
* **Audio:** Fade in the gentle, contemplative track (`calm_ambient`). Viviana’s voiceover explains the premise of her book *Playful Pottery* and how it diverges from traditional rigid manuals by prioritizing exploration and accessibility [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 37.6s-57.4s]].
* **Purpose:** Introduce the book's core premise and establish the tactile visual world of her work.

---

#### **Beat 3: Creativity and Kindness (0:28 – 0:48)**
* **Visual:** A focused montage of Viviana working at the pottery wheel, shaping clay with care [[clip: B003C006_240719KM | 56.9s-64.8s]], refining pottery edges [[clip: B003C006_240719KM | 136.4s-145.1s]], and handling delicate sculptural forms [[clip: B003C028_240719CX | 15.1s-20.8s]].
* **Audio:** Over the ambient bed, Viviana elaborates on the book's primary lesson: practicing kindness toward oneself, letting go of perfectionism, and embracing the joy of making mistakes during creative exploration [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 119.8s-130.5s]].
* **Purpose:** Deliver the philosophical heart of the piece, linking ceramic technique to self-compassion.

---

#### **Beat 4: Completion & Joyful Outro (0:48 – 1:00)**
* **Visual:** Viviana putting the final touches on a completed piece on the wheel [[clip: B003C011_240719YX | 198.4s-206s]]. Cut to a close shot of Viviana smiling and giggling warmly to camera [[clip: B003C039_240719DU | 7.9s-9.8s]].
* **Audio:** Final uplifting voiceover reflection resolves as the ambient track gently fades out under her laughter.
* **Purpose:** End on an uplifting, playful note that embodies the spirit of *Playful Pottery*.

### Story Beat 1: Introduction & The Mud Witch Vibe (0:00 – 0:15)
* **Visual:** Open on the storefront exterior sign as Viviana enters her shop. [[clip: A001C001_240718YG | 2.8s-8s]] Cut inside to tight B-roll close-ups showcasing colorful, handcrafted ceramics on display. [[clip: B003C028_240719CX | 5.8s-11.2s]]
* **Audio / Music:** Upbeat, groovy music begins immediately under the opening shot. Viviana opens in voiceover: *"It's a lot of work, but it's a dream to be a full time artist."* [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 1257.6s-1263.8s]]
* **Interview Setup:** Cut directly to Viviana on camera during interview prep as she laughs and says, *"I love the winging it style interview,"* followed by genuine giggles. [[clip: A001C002_240718OR | 14s-25s]] She then warmly introduces herself: *"I'm Viviana..."* [[clip: A001C002_240718OR | 48s-54.2s]]
* **Purpose:** Establishes Viviana’s fun, approachable personality, her artist identity, and the colorful world of Mud Witch.

---

### Story Beat 2: Clay Meets Body Positivity (0:15 – 0:40)
* **Visual:** Intercut between Viviana speaking on camera and B-roll of pottery shaping, glazing, and finished distinctive mugs. [[clip: B003C011_240719YX | 21.3s-37.9s]]
* **Dialogue / Voiceover:**
  * Viviana frames her creative philosophy: *"I think being open minded when it comes to design is really important."* [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 693.9s-702.1s]]
  * She explains the origin of her signature aesthetic: *"when I was learning to do ceramics, I was also learning about the body positivity movement..."* [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 702.3s-707.8s]]
  * She highlights her signature pieces: *"I was like starting to make these like chubby shapes and they're literally called this is the Chubby Mug. This is the Venus mug..."* [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 709.9s-721s]]
  * She wraps up the concept: *"I think those two things kind of just mushed together the learning clay and the body positivity."* [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 721.7s-728.5s]]
* **Purpose:** Connects her design language directly to personal values and empowerment.

---

### Story Beat 3: Valuing Objects & Playful Outro (0:40 – 0:60)
* **Visual:** Transition into tactile detail shots of finished ceramics in the store. [[clip: B003C050_240719XK | 9.6s-14.2s]] Cut to the final visual of Viviana walking into frame, striking a cute, goofy pose, and walking out. [[clip: B003C039_240719DU | 7.9s-9.8s]]
* **Audio / Music:** The music transitions to a warmer, more reflective track under the dialogue.
* **Dialogue / Voiceover:**
  * Viviana reflects: *"one of my bigger spiel or whatever is that we need to really think about stuff like take a pause and think about the value of items..."* [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 1151.6s-1168.7s]]
  * Concluding voiceover line lands over the final pose: *"I want a select few things that I know will bring me happiness."* [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 1172.1s-1197.2s]]
* **Purpose:** Leaves the viewer with a thoughtful reflection on intentional living while ending on her signature charm and humor.

* **Visual & Dialogue:** Feature a punchy 14-second cut of Dwight encountering the actor sitting at Jim's desk, growing visibly distressed and bewildered as Pam kisses the replacement Jim and confirms dinner plans. [[clip: office | 1116s-1207s]]
* **Purpose:** Delivers quick side-character comedy centered on Dwight's signature paranoia and confusion.

**Beat 4: The Chore Wheel Spin**
* **Visual & Dialogue:** Cut to the office gathering around the spinning chore wheel as Kevin roots for a prize, only for the wheel to land squarely on mug duty to his immediate dismay. [[clip: office | 1501.09s-1515.18s]]
* **Purpose:** Introduces an ensemble comedic beat highlighting the office's collective absurdity before moving into the final manager-employee exchange.

* **Visual & Dialogue:** Transition directly into Michael and Dwight's interaction, completely bypassing any setup footage featuring Pam, focusing solely on Michael asking if the room smells like "updog," Dwight walking into the punchline, and Michael celebrating his victory before asking how Dwight is doing. ### Beat 1: Cold Open & Artist Introduction (0:00–0:14)
- **Visual:** The video opens with complete silence over a macro close-up of Viviana steadily glazing the interior of a ceramic bowl. [[clip: B003C006_240719KM | 56.9s-64.8s]]
- **Audio:** Audio fades in over the continued glazing visual with her opening philosophy: *"I think being open minded when it comes to design is really important."* [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 147.4s-151.6s]]
- **Visual & Audio Transition:** Cut to Viviana speaking in her studio as she introduces herself: *"Hi, I'm Viviana Matsuda. Um, I do pottery for a living. My brand name is Mud Witch. Um, yeah. I'm a full time potter."* [[clip: A001C002_240718OR | 14s-25s]]

---

### Beat 2: Introducing *Playful Pottery* (0:14–0:32)
- **A1 (Interview):** Cut on-camera to Viviana introducing the title and premise of her book: *"So my book is called Playful Pottery. I wanted something that was a more simplified book about pottery for beginners."* [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 26.2s-28.5s]] [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 30s-37.6s]]
- **B1 (B-Roll):** Cut to a colorful shelf display of her playful finished creations, showing sunglasses resting on decorative plates and ice cream sundae figurines. [[clip: B003C050_240719XK | 21.5s-25.2s]] [[clip: B003C050_240719XK | 29.2s-33.9s]]
- **A2 (Interview):** Return to Viviana explaining why she wanted to depart from traditional ceramics guides: *"I feel like what I always saw or referenced were these, like, big, hearty old school books that never really talked about color or, um, had super fun things to do in them. Um, very like old school pottery."* [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 37.6s-57.4s]]
- **B2 (B-Roll):** Cut to b-roll of her finished pastel ceramics, watermelon containers, and mugs arranged neatly on display shelves. [[clip: B003C050_240719XK | 9.6s-14.2s]]

---

### Beat 3: The Core Lesson — Creativity and Kindness (0:32–0:48)
- **A3 (Interview):** Viviana speaks on the book's deeper message for learners: *"I hope the book provides to its readers... general clay knowledge. But also, I really want people to be creative and be kind to themselves."* [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 86.9s-98s]] [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 98s-107.6s]]
- **B3 (B-Roll):** Cut to a sunny windowsill work area showcasing potted plants and small cat pottery figurines. [[clip: B003C017_240719GP | 5.2s-8.6s]]
- **Focused Visual + Stance on Creativity:** Cut to a medium shot of Viviana deeply focused at her work table while painting a bowl [[clip: B003C006_240719KM | 157.5s-166.6s]], carrying her voiceover about creative pressure: *"I think that was like the main theme was creativity involves, um, being kind to yourself, which I don't think is talked about as much as it should be."* [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 107.6s-119.7s]]

---

### Beat 4: Resolution & Conclusion (0:48–1:00)
- **Visual & Audio:** Cut back to Viviana on camera in her studio to close on an empowering, direct message about embracing imperfections in the creative process: *"When you're kind to yourself, you are rolling with the punches. You are more open to be flexible with your designs, and you can end up with something that turns out way better than your original design."* [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 133.5s-147.2s]]

### 1. Launch & River Run (0:00 – 0:15)
- **Goal**: Establish the grand outdoor setting, set an upbeat tempo, and get the paddlers moving onto the water.
- **Audio**: Introduce energetic backing music with *cheerful_ragtime* [[sound: 50d3dfec-7814-4b99-8df3-6f50dbfddfc4]] at full volume.
- **Visuals & Editing**:
  - Open with the wide establishing shot of a kayak paddling beneath a towering cliff face [[clip: DJI_20260809102052_0140_D | 0s-15s]] (~4s).
  - Cut on action to pushing off from the sandy riverbank [[clip: DJI_20260807125140_0011_D | 0s-8s]] (~4s).
  - Transition smoothly via a camera tilt down from rushing clear water into forward paddling motion [[clip: DJI_20260807131753_0016_D | 3s-14s]] (~4s).

---

### 2. River Action & Midpoint Comedy (0:15 – 0:30)
- **Goal**: Highlight the high-energy excitement, river play, and spontaneous humor of the trip.
- **Audio**: Briefly duck the music bed to bring out natural splash sounds and lively shouts from the crew.
- **Visuals & Editing**:
  - Cut to fast first-person POV paddling with energetic cheering [[clip: DJI_20260808160313_0098_D | 0s-14s]] (~4s).
  - Hard cut on movement to a swimmer diving forward into the river [[clip: DJI_20260808153501_0093_D | 1s-8s]] (~4s), followed by a playful water dunk and splash [[clip: DJI_20260808131518_0081_D | 0s-3.8s]] (~3s).
  - *Midpoint Comedic Beat*: Insert the requested funny moment from `DJI_20260809082655_0123_D.MP4` (~4s). *(Note: This clip is missing from the current project media pool and requires sourcing from the raw files).*

---

### 3. River Obstacles & Camp Life (0:30 – 0:46)
- **Goal**: Showcase trip challenges and cozy moments off the water to maintain variety.
- **Audio**: Layer a natural scraping sound effect synchronized with the canoe sliding over the log obstacle, blending back into the music bed and the sizzle of camp cooking.
- **Visuals & Editing**:
  - Focus on hauling the canoe over a submerged log obstacle [[clip: DJI_20260808174516_0110_D | 0s-13.6s]] (~5s).
  - Match the tree theme with a canoe gliding smoothly underneath a fallen tree trunk [[clip: DJI_20260809100115_0137_D | 0s-6s]] (~4s).
  - Cut to camp life: steak sizzling on a portable pan [[clip: DJI_20260807195658_0045_D | 5s-10s]] (~4s), followed by early morning wading through river mist [[clip: DJI_20260808074507_0053_D | 0s-18s]] (~4s).

---

### 4. Wildlife & Scenic Finale (0:46 – 1:00)
- **Goal**: Close the montage on a charming, visually stunning high note.
- **Audio**: Dip music slightly for the farewell dialogue, then swell the track for the final panoramic landscape before a clean resolve.
- **Visuals & Editing**:
  - Quick wildlife interaction: Woman waving goodbye to the butterfly [[clip: DJI_20260807170417_0037_D | 21.9s-23.5s]] (~3s).
  - Cut to rhythmic, sunlit paddling across open water [[clip: DJI_20260808112917_0066_D | 0s-12s]] (~4s).
  - Final shot: Hold on the sweeping, scenic pan across clear turquoise spring water and the historic stone structure [[clip: DJI_20260808125038_0073_D | 12s-24s]] (~5s) to fade out.

### Editorial Plan: Jason Deck / Nice Jewish Runners (60 Seconds - 9:16 Vertical for IG Stories)

* **Format & Visual Framing:** Edited in 9:16 vertical format tailored for Instagram Stories. A-roll interview shots are centered for vertical viewing, while all B-roll is dynamically reframed and cropped to track the subject and spotlight the most visually engaging focal points of each visual. Apply a vibrant, natural color grade across all flat log footage to normalize contrast, restore authentic skin tones, and bring out rich outdoor tones in the track surface, foliage, and sky without oversaturating.

---

#### Story Beat 1: Identity & Athletic Foundation (0:00 – 0:14)
* **Goal & Mood:** Establish Jason's identity as a competitive Jewish athlete with an intimate, cinematic opening.
* **A-Roll / Dialogue:** Open on Jason introducing himself and his club: "My name's Jason Deck, I live in Brooklyn, New York, and I run with Nice Jewish Runners." [[clip: P1071636-003 | 114.81s-119.53s]] Allow a beat of visual breathing room over B-roll before cutting to him summarizing his pride: "And I think that's like the biggest thing, especially as somebody who takes athletics with pride and also Judaism." [[clip: P1071637-002 | 68.69s-77.5s]]
* **B-Roll / Visuals:** Cut to 50% slow-mo portrait smile as Jason says his name. [[clip: P1071658 | 1s-6s]] Begin the training progression in slow motion with Jason tying his running shoes on a park bench [[clip: P1071641 | 27.63s-41.22s]], transitioning to him warming up with hamstring stretches along the track [[clip: P1071643 | 0s-6.9s]] and a quad stretch by the railing [[clip: P1071645 | 8s-16.59s]]. Overlay warm light flares to establish an elevated, cinematic tone [[clip: Lens_Flare_From_The_Street_Light_fhd_1184157 | 2s-10s]].
* **Music & Audio:** A subtle, contemplative instrumental track enters softly underneath, building atmospheric warmth. On-screen graphic introduces his name and club affiliation: *Jason Deck – Nice Jewish Runners*.

---

#### Story Beat 2: Yearning for Community & Jewish Pride (0:14 – 0:30)
* **Goal & Mood:** Shift to an emotional, reflective tone tailored for Jewish American Heritage Month, emphasizing solidarity and shared heritage.
* **A-Roll / Dialogue:** Jason reflects on searching for connection: "...the one thing that I did see was a strong Jewish connection, and that was something I was yearning for, especially after October 7th, and even during some of the marathons that I had run, I was writing stuff like Am Yisrael Chai on my shoes, and nice Jewish runners was literally a club dedicated to that phrase," [[clip: P1071636-003 | 337.91s-343.29s]] [[clip: P1071636-003 | 343.63s-361.39s]]. Hold a pause over B-roll to let the sentence settle cleanly before he adds the pride of racing openly: "I get the pleasure of running with a nice Jewish club. Wearing McGein David on my penny and competing in races." [[clip: P1071637-002 | 59.05s-68.43s]]
* **B-Roll / Visuals:** Slow-motion detail shots showcasing cultural identity: a close-up of Jason wearing his silver Mezuzah and Star of David necklace [[clip: P1071659 | 4s-10.64s]], a low side lunge stretch on the track surface [[clip: P1071646 | 0s-7.02s]], and a close-up of the NJR logo on his jacket [[clip: P1071652 | 7s-14s]].
* **Editing & Pacing:** Slower cuts with deliberate focus on personal and cultural symbols, allowing breathing space between soundbites so the gravity of his words can resonate.

---

#### Story Beat 3: The Energy of the Run (0:30 – 0:45)
* **Goal & Mood:** Transition into high-energy, epic athletic motion, showing how team support elevates his performance.
* **A-Roll / Dialogue:** Jason describes hearing support along the course: "But the one thing I do keep hearing is like NJR or like people showing in support. And for me, that's pretty special because I didn't have a team before coming to New York." [[clip: P1071637-002 | 292.04s-303.84s]] Let the sentence ring out and breathe before transitioning to his physical reaction: "You get that little tingle in the back of your skull and it's a really good feeling and it just makes you want to like do even better." [[clip: P1071637-002 | 320.62s-328.5s]]
* **B-Roll / Visuals:** Peak training flow in cinematic slow motion: tracking behind Jason as he jogs steadily on the track [[clip: P1071651 | 8.52s-14.42s]], an overhead aerial perspective tracking him running through New York streets [[clip: DJI_20260503181611_0001_D | 43s-75s]], a side-profile tracking shot in bright sun [[clip: P1071655 | 0s-4s]], and a powerful shot of Jason striding directly past the lens [[clip: P1071656 | 0.24s-8s]].
* **Editing & Pacing:** The musical bed swells with driving rhythm, matching rhythmic cuts of full-stride running while preserving audio breathing room at the ends of spoken sentences.

---

#### Story Beat 4: An Open Invitation (0:45 – 1:00)
* **Goal & Mood:** Conclude with warmth, joy, and the creative brief's requirement that the run club is open to everyone regardless of pace.
* **A-Roll / Dialogue:** Jason closes with an inviting smile, allowing his final line to finish completely with natural trailing room: "Run with nice Jewish runners, and it's it's a great feeling to be around people that are willing to go pretty much any speed and Just have a conversation get some bopka and coffee after it's great" [[clip: P1071638 | 183.67s-197.5s]]
* **B-Roll / Visuals:** Visuals resolve on Jason breaking into a genuine, relaxed smile directly at the camera [[clip: P1071658 | 1s-6s]], layered with warm lens flare light leaks [[clip: Lens_Flare_From_The_Street_Light_fhd_1184157 | 2s-10s]].
* **Music & Graphics:** Music resolves warmly, sustaining for a beat after Jason finishes speaking. Closing text slate displays: *Celebrating Jewish American Heritage Month* alongside the Nice Jewish Runners club logo and call-to-action. Fade to black.

projects.initialPlanText:
### Story Beat 1: Creative Exploration & Opening Hook (0:00–0:15)
- **Audio & Dialogue:** The track *groovy_fun* starts on the very first frame [[sound: 86392f75-a457-45c9-a516-686cbbd2e5e5]], playing underneath Viviana's opening A-roll audio as she describes the open-ended creative process: "what if this, instead of a tulip was a daffodil? And let's try to achieve that..." [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 501.6s-521.3s]].
- **Visuals:** Cover the opening A-roll voiceover with close-up B-roll of hands centering and shaping clay on the wheel [[clip: B003C011_240719YX | 5.9s-9.1s]].
- **Purpose:** Establish an energetic, inviting tone and introduce the playful curiosity at the heart of her craft.

---

### Story Beat 2: Introducing *Playful Pottery* (0:15–0:27)
- **Audio & Dialogue:** Directly following the opening hook, cut to Viviana on camera stating, "So my book is called Playful Pottery" [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 26.2s-28.5s]]. She expands on her goal to create an accessible guide: "I wanted something that was a more simplified book about pottery for beginners." [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 30s-37.6s]].
- **Visuals:** Start on A-roll interview framing, then cut to B-roll of playful, colorful ceramic figurines on studio shelves [[clip: B003C050_240719XK | 21.5s-25.2s]].
- **Purpose:** Clearly state the subject of the film and connect the book's title to its beginner-friendly ethos.

---

### Story Beat 3: Overcoming Creative Pressure with Flexibility (0:27–0:48)
- **Audio & Dialogue:** Viviana speaks about the stress artists face: "I think that there's a pressure to produce things. As a creative person, but not to be kind of kind to yourself about what the process is going to be like" [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 119.8s-130.5s]]. Right after, transition directly into her realization: "when you're kind to yourself, you are rolling with the punches. You are more open to be flexible with your designs, and you can end up with something that turns out way better than your original design." [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 133.5s-147.2s]].
- **Visuals:** Support with B-roll of delicate ceramic painting [[clip: B003C006_240719KM | 56.9s-64.8s]] and examining finished pottery pieces on shelves [[clip: B003C005_240719NB | 0.8s-13.5s]].
- **Purpose:** Highlight the central philosophical conflict—production pressure versus creative adaptability.

---

### Story Beat 4: Kindness in Creativity & Closing (0:48–1:00)
- **Audio & Dialogue:** Viviana delivers the concluding spoken line: "creativity involves, um, being kind to yourself, which I don't think is Talked about as much as it should be." [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 107.6s-119.7s]]. 
- **Visuals & Graphics:** Cut from a shot of colorful ceramic tableware [[clip: B003C050_240719XK | 29.2s-33.9s]] directly into an end-title text box displaying book information and closing credits as *groovy_fun* resolves.
- **Purpose:** Leave the viewer with the core moral of the book—practicing self-compassion throughout the creative journey.
